events.what_it_is: Cherry Bombe's ten-day Fashion Week house with food, fashion, shopping, community programming, live podcasts, cookbook signings and a cafe.
events.what_is_free: General walk-in access to Cherry Bombe House is open to the public during the published public hours. Individual talks and special programs may require a paid ticket, reservation or application.
events.caveats: Cherry Bombe states that the House is open to the public and walk-ins are welcome from 10 AM–4 PM daily September 9–18. Some individual events inside the House are separately ticketed, reservation-based or application-based.
events.practical_notes: You can walk in during the general public hours without buying a ticket, but check the schedule before planning around a specific talk, podcast or class.

events.event_name: The Untitled Magazine NYFW at Avenue Sky Lounge
events.address: Avenue Sky Lounge at The Edge, Floor 101, 30 Hudson Yards, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: An NYFW evening hosted by The Untitled Magazine with DJs The Muses and Eva Vos, cocktails and bites at Avenue Sky Lounge.
events.what_is_free: Cocktails and bites are advertised for invited guests; the source does not establish public admission or a public ticket price.
events.caveats: The Untitled Magazine explicitly says RSVP REQUIRED and invite only. A public direct RSVP URL is not exposed on the verified page.
events.practical_notes: Do not treat this as a walk-in event. Only go if you have an invitation or confirmed access.

events.event_name: CookUnity: The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.neighborhood: Chelsea / Flatiron / Midtown / Murray Hill / West Village
events.address: Five Manhattan bodegas: 266 W 23rd St; 873 Broadway; 369 Madison Ave; 451 Third Ave; 275 W 4th St
events.what_it_is: A one-day CookUnity chef takeover at five Manhattan bodegas, with celebrity and internet-famous chefs serving CookUnity meals and hot samples.
events.what_is_free: Free hot samples and full cold-packaged CookUnity meals are advertised while supplies last. Guests also receive a scratch-off for a chance at additional prizes.
events.caveats: Open to the public, but all food is while supplies last. The activation runs simultaneously across five Manhattan bodegas.
events.practical_notes: Choose the most convenient bodega and arrive early if the free meal is your priority.

events.event_name: Extra Butter × Brooks × Alex Zono Urban Wildlife Run
events.address: Extra Butter, 125 Orchard St, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: A community run celebrating the launch of the Alex Zono × Brooks Ghost Trail Runners, beginning from Extra Butter's Lower East Side store.
events.what_is_free: Participation in the run is free, but spots are limited and advance RSVP is required.
events.caveats: Extra Butter states that run spots are limited and RSVP is required through the link in its bio. The direct Luma destination is linked from Extra Butter's current Linktree but is not stored here as a verified stable direct URL.
events.practical_notes: Runners meet at 9:30 AM at Extra Butter; the run begins at 10 AM.

events.event_name: Extra Butter × Brooks × Alex Zono Launch Mixer
events.address: Extra Butter, 125 Orchard St, New York, NY 10002
events.what_it_is: The public post-run launch mixer for the Alex Zono × Brooks Ghost Trail Runners at Extra Butter, with beverages, bites, a photo booth and recovery station.
events.what_is_free: The launch mixer is explicitly open to the public with no RSVP required. The organizer also advertises beverages, bites, a photo booth and a recovery station.
events.caveats: The mixer is separate from the limited-capacity morning run. No RSVP is needed for the mixer according to Extra Butter's current post.
events.practical_notes: If you only want the public mixer, arrive between noon and 4 PM; you do not need to join the run.

events.what_it_is: A two-day Estée Lauder pop-up for the new Glimmer Eau de Parfum in the West Village.
events.what_is_free: Free access to experience the Glimmer fragrance. Secondary event coverage also advertises a chance at a free Estée Lauder product and photo moments; quantities and eligibility are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current NYC event coverage confirms the September 11–12 pop-up at 711 Greenwich Street. Friday and Saturday have different opening times. The Estée Lauder corporate release independently confirms the Glimmer fragrance launch but does not list the pop-up address or hours.
events.practical_notes: Friday opens at 12:30 PM; Saturday opens at 11 AM. Both days close at 7 PM.
